summary: React web framework runtime and scaffold.
overview: Next.js runtime environment with a built-in scaffold workflow. Upload your project source, install dependencies automatically, build, and run it on the bundled Node runtime.
description:
Next.js is the React framework maintained by Vercel for building full-stack web applications with routing, rendering, data fetching, and deployment tooling. This package provides a self-hosted runtime environment for Next.js projects instead of a finished business app.

On first startup, if the mounted source directory is empty, the package scaffolds a default Next.js 16.3.5 project with create-next-app. When a user later uploads their own Next.js project source into the mounted app directory, the container automatically detects the package manager, installs dependencies, builds the project, and starts it with `next start`.

Typical use cases include development sandboxes, customer-owned runtime environments, internal app hosting, and managed self-hosting where users want to upload already-developed Next.js code and run it without preparing a custom Docker image first.
